scope: Independent Chromium contexts on one GB300 Fury, local HTTP and actual existing private HTTPS/WSS. No physically separate client, physical microphone/speaker, fresh hardware installation, or new model boot claim.

concurrent_workflows.original_failure: Advanced controls intercepted the final preview-refresh click after successful generation. Fixed in-flow layout and close-on-start. concurrent_workflows.passive_performance_scope: Small measured operator CPU use while two passive displays were open; no controlled before/after latency experiment.

Final retained-output harness initially expected an obsolete nested frame and injected sessionStorage into opaque sandbox frames. Harness corrected; 20 output-layout cases and local/private downloads passed.
